method: Headless Chromium using the exact index HTML, CSS, embedded data payload and application JavaScript. The environment blocked direct file/localhost navigation, so the same assets were injected into a blank page for interaction QA; ordinary HTTP serving was checked separately with HTTP 200 responses.

checks.observed: Executive overview visible; title correct; first KPI 20 decisions.
Inspect action opened Product identity and boundary with source links and complete JSON.
index.html, app.js, research descriptor and executive report returned HTTP 200.

limitations: This is a Chromium smoke test, not cross-browser or assistive-technology certification.

Direct file:// and localhost navigation were blocked by the managed browser policy in this execution environment; static serving was verified with curl and runtime assets were tested by exact-content injection.
